lines.text: Jacob sees Esau coming with four hundred men, arranges his family, and bows to the ground seven times.
Esau runs to Jacob and embraces him, and Jacob's family then bows down before Esau.
Esau says he already has plenty, but Jacob presses him until he accepts the gift.
Jacob asks Esau to go ahead because the children are frail, and Esau returns to Hebron that day.
Jacob builds a house at Succoth, buys land near Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver, and sets up a pillar.
